_readme: Fallback rules for a school zone that is mapped (e.g. OpenStreetMap hazard=school_zone) but has no hours of its own. ONLY rows verified against an official source are listed; a region without a row gets no school-zone alert (the normal posted limit is shown). See NOTES.md > School zones.

rows.days: School days: every day that is not a weekend, a NSW public holiday or a publicly notified NSW government school holiday (pupil-free staff development days inside term are school-zone days).
rows.source: Transport for NSW, Speed Zones dataset (School Zones data, updated 2026-11-05) and School Zone Timetables dataset description, opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au/data/dataset/speed-zones, CC BY 4.0. The default hours are those of 3,219 of the 3,302 NSW zones in that data; zones with their own hours use them.
